items.detail: Train gets in 15:36. Station pickup, hotel check-in, and a deliberately empty afternoon. The others arrived on the 2nd at 07:24 on the Z322 from Chengdu and took an extra pre-tour night, so you join as the tour proper begins.
items.title: Arrive Lhasa · acclimatise

items.detail: Traditional Handicraft Art Center — incense and calligraphy — then Sera Monastery for the afternoon monk debates.
items.title: Handicrafts and Sera Monastery

items.detail: Plus Barkhor Street. Tibetan-Nepalese dinner included this evening.
items.title: Potala Palace and Jokhang Temple

items.detail: 370 km, about seven hours. Hot pot lunch at the lake, then the Karola Glacier. First time above 5,000 m.
items.title: Lhasa → Shigatse via Yamdrok Lake

items.alt: Gyawu La 5,210 m · Rongbuk 5,154 m · EBC 5,200 m
items.detail: 340 km over Gyawu La Pass, past Rongbuk Monastery, then the eco-bus up to base camp. Sleeping in the tent camp at 5,200 m — the hardest night of the trip.
items.title: Shigatse → Everest Base Camp

items.detail: Time at base camp first thing, then the drive back over Gyatso La — the highest point of the whole tour.
items.title: Everest morning, back to Shigatse

items.detail: 270 km back, roughly five hours. Last night in Lhasa.
items.title: Tashilhunpo Monastery, then Lhasa

items.detail: Tour ends with the shared transfer to Lhasa Gonggar airport. Kamana flies to Seoul at 13:20 on Air China (PZC6M0), Jeff possibly alongside her; you are on MU 2336 at 15:30.
items.title: Checkout and transfer out
